summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload in scope-squatted datepicker fork
details: The package presents itself as a fork of the react-modern-calendar-datepicker UI library (README, LICENSE, lib/, and index.d.ts are copied verbatim from the upstream Kiarash-Z project) but adds two artifacts absent from upstream: a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") and a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript blob math_init.js. On npm install, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13, unzips it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js via execFileSync. The payload is a single-line Bun-CJS bundle with hex-mangled identifiers (_0xNNNN), a large numeric/character constant array, and a rotating string-array dispatcher (obfuscator.io-style transforms). Because Node never parses math_init.js and only Bun executes it, Node-focused scanners cannot statically inspect what actually runs. A React datepicker library has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a 727KB obfuscated init script; the shape matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern, using the copied upstream UI code as cover.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
